notes.title: Difficulty Overhaul
notes.content: Fixed a bug that was keeping the difficulty setting from working.  Players should notice a huge difference now when selecting difficulty settings, especially Hell Cometh.

notes.title: Updated Map
notes.content:
So I've been wanting to update the playground since it was the very first map I made for this game.  The new version looks better, if more fun to play and should be more FPS friendly.

Added the ability to flip the Y-Axis on the controls page for those who want to switch your vertical direction.

Two new achievements for each map that allow you to start with the rifle and possibly even the grenade launcher depending on your kill streak for that map.  And as with all achievements added, they will add retroactively if your streak record is high enough.

And one final thing is a request from me to you.  Worth a buck?  Give me a review as it would help to have a few more.  Got some constructive criticism?  Let me know.  Thanks.

notes.title: So was gonna do an update one week after launch...
notes.content:
But just like with the launch, why wait if it's done early?

Some bug fixes such as issues with names not showing up correctly for other players, Zombies not playing the correct animations when attacking and some issues related to respawning.

Added a credits screen to give credit to the artists who helped with this title.

Added a tips screen to help explain mechanics.

Added an achievements screen so you can check out what you've unlocked.

And speaking of achievements, added a dozen new achievements.
